t: A handheld screen, speaker and battery that turns a HackRF One into a pocket radio.
steps: Buy an H4M kit with a HackRF from OpenSourceSDRLab or a radio shop such as Lab401.
Charge it with a USB-C cable and attach the included antenna.
Check the firmware version in the settings menu.
Download the latest Mayhem release from its GitHub page and follow the wiki update steps.
Open the spectrum app and watch the waterfall for local signals.
Try the ADS-B app to list nearby planes.
Read your local radio rules before you touch any transmit app.
